title: Tailing Tales

services.name: Snook Fishing
services.desc: As we wrap up the end of the year fishing Id like to thank all clients for fishing with me!Starting my 22nd year guiding Ive outfitted the boat with more features to accommodate better fishing with power pole trolling motor which is very reliable and quiet and all new upholstery for more family comfort. As we go into 2026 starting with bottom fishing on public and private spots many fishermen around or near me we all enjoying the reefs and wrecks around Anna Maria has a lot to offer. If your a beginner or advanced Im always ready. As the weather starts to warm the action will be awaiting the trout, snook, redfish to become more active. services.name: Eco Tours
services.desc: Tailing Tales Charters also provides Eco Tours for up to 6 people in Sarasota, Bradenton, Anna Maria Island, Tampa Bay, and the surrounding areas. These tours are a good way to see the backwater preserves and tributaries, and beaches that are only accessible by boat. On a eco tour, you’ll likely see dolphins, manatees, marine life, and all kinds of birds. You can also bring snorkel gear to observe the underwater environment. A deposit is required upon scheduling a charter with Tailing Tales. The deposit is fully refundable if the charter is cancelled 1-2 weeks in advance, or at the discrepancy of Capt.
